echo "d025 GSM8K PID: $!"

    --model_path /root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3___1-8B \
    --adapter_path /root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B_d100_s0/lora_adapter \
    --benchmarks gsm8k \

```
